# sophosfirewall_service_group (Data Source)

Looks up an existing service group by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_service_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the service group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `services` (Set of String) Names of the member services, e.g. `HTTPS` or a `sophosfirewall_service` name.
